answer: An agent joins only by posting a refundable stake, and its identity is tied to an anchor: a long-lived account with a verified payment history. Each anchor supports at most three agents, so a thousand fake identities need a thousand aged anchors. Stakes are locked for 90 days and slashed if peers' audits catch collusion, so ferrous, honest agents pay little while a sybil farm must tie up capital and watch it drain. Like water through karst, fake reputation leaks out through audit gaps.
